value: O Gladsome Light of the holy glory of the Immortal Father, heavenly, holy, blessed, O Jesus Christ: having come to the setting of the sun, beholding the evening light, we praise the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit: God. Meet it is for Thee at all times to be hymned with reverent voices, O Son of God, Giver of Life; wherefore the world doth glorify Thee.
